name: Mainburg Mitterleite / Wambach data center
developer: Betriebs- und Entwicklungsgesellschaft Mainburg with unnamed private investor
notes: Mainburg Bau- und Umweltausschuss agenda records a preliminary decision for construction of a data center at Mitterleite 13 in Wambach, Gemarkung Lindkirchen, approved unchanged on 2025-04-08. City year-end note references detailed plans for data center settlement. ÖDP local release says 150 MW was initially targeted and 500 MW was discussed; capacity entered as 150 MW due lower explicit target.
